entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. Get me a person now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable. I've been trying to figure this out for an hour.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can I get your name and order number?
It's Mark Peterson, order 774-B2-910. And you better solve this, or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.

Thank you for that information, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Are you kidding me? It's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I need to do an exchange, and I need it handled right now. I don't have time for this.
I understand completely. I apologize that the fit wasn't right for you. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. I see it was delivered 69 days ago.
So what? Are you going to tell me I'm out of luck now? I swear if you do, I'm demanding to speak to your manager immediately.

Not at all, sir. I've confirmed that for this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you. We can either issue a full refund or set up that exchange for a larger size. Which would you prefer?
Oh. You... you can? Well, an exchange then. I want an exchange for a size Large.

Excellent. I've just initiated an exchange for the same jersey in a size Large. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just print that out, place the original item back in its packaging, and drop it at a shipping center. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll send out the new one.
Okay. That's... that's fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
